newsitem.title: BRUNEI: Kohl says EMU to be completed on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says EMU to be completed on schedule.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Thursday that European Monetary Union will be completed as scheduled.
"The house of Europe will be built. Monetary Union will be completed as scheduled," Kohl said in a speech in Brunei's capital, according to a text of the speech received in advance.
European monetary union is scheduled to start on January 1, 1999.
Kohl's two-day official visit to Brunei is part of a 12-day tour of Asia which includes stops in Australia, New Zealand and Hong Kong.
Earlier on Thursday, Kohl agreed to strengthen ties with Brunei during talks with the country's Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah, German officials said.

Also on Thursday, Brunei's Oil and Gas Agency said it had signed a letter of intent to build a refinery in Brunei costing 2.6 billion marks ($1.5 billion) with state-owned German engineering company IAB.
